Subject: Quick recap + next steps (follow-up from today's demo)

Hi Samantha / Tim —

Thanks again for the time today — great conversation and good initial alignment on where Redwood can help reduce inference costs and stabilize latency for your transaction routing use cases. Quick recap and next steps so nothing falls through the cracks: 

- What we demoed: hosted Redwood API for fast POC + option to move to Dedicated pools for predictable throughput.
- Primary success metric: reduce inference cost per authorization by 30% while keeping p95 latency < 150ms.
- Action items we took on the call:
  1) We (Redwood) to share an initial SOW and intake for procurement — attached (Redwood-SOW-v1.pdf).
  2) Greenfield to route to procurement and counsel; anticipated timeline: procurement review this week, counsel review next week.
  3) Rafael will schedule a technical follow-up to confirm metric instrumentation and sample workloads.

Next steps (proposed):
- Tim / procurement: confirm who will own the legal redlines and whether we should expect them back by EOD Friday (Feb 12).
- Samantha: if there are internal milestones or procurement windows we should know about, flag them here and we'll prioritize.
- Rafael / Evelyn: tentatively schedule the technical sync for week of Feb 16 (we can move if redlines push timing).

If it's helpful, Marissa is copied to prioritize any commercial questions on the deal. Laura is on copy for legal intake if counsel needs anything from our side.

Thanks — look forward to the next steps.

Best,
Evelyn

Evelyn —

Thanks for the recap. Procurement started a pass and counsel made a few redline requests — attaching our consolidated comments (GF-Redlines_v1.pdf). High level:

- Data residency clause: request to add explicit US-only residency and a 30-day data export guarantee.
- Audit logs / retention: asking for 7 years of retention and SOC2 evidence.
- Liability cap: proposed a lower cap for pilot phase.
- IP / derivative works: minor language tweaks.

We'd like to get a read from your legal team on what you can accept vs. what needs negotiation. Our timeline: counsel prefers to circle back by end-of-week (Feb 12).

Thanks —
